author: OrnaOdie
body: What quality is the equipment when it is dismantled? By your screenshots, you’re auto dismantling anything below legendary quality. That’ll include most, if not all, of your drops.

author: zombiesDONTwipe
body: The auto dismantle filter will dismantle any item that fits in ANY of the checked boxes. If you're only getting famed or worse items from Apollyon, even if they're tier 9, they're going to be dismantled. You can turn off the filter if you want, but it might be best to leave it as is since you probably don't want to upgrade the Apollyon gear unless it's legendary or better anyways!
